title: The Federal Reserve describes itself as the U.S. central bank created by the Federal Reserve Act of 1913
summary: The Federal Reserve describes itself as the U.S. central bank created by the Federal Reserve Act of 1913.
body: The Board's structure page says the Federal Reserve is the U.S. central bank, created by the Federal Reserve Act of 1913 to establish a monetary system that could respond to stresses in the banking system. The source says: "central bank, created by the Federal Reserve Act of 1913 to establish a monetary system that could respond effectively to stresses in the banking system." That is the institution's account of its origin and purpose. It is not a history of every crisis since 1913.
